note: Debt recorded when pnpm forge:packet-lint was introduced (2026-09-15, FORGE-GATES-01). Each key is `path::rule`; a finding listed here is reported as a warning instead of failing the lint, so a NEW violation blocks while this pre-existing debt does not disable the gate on day one. Remove keys as the debt is paid; never add a key to silence a violation you just introduced.
